scope: P01 onward, including future added pages
purpose: Keep ornament production rooted in Rurubu-style editorial design, coherent as Rurubu WEDDING V30, adaptable by page role, scalable when pages are added, protected from accidental exact-asset carry-over, and protected from cross-page illustration-genre drift.

authorityModel.principle: P01/P02 are current live style anchors for the active V30 publication family, not layout templates. Target-page Visual Masters control local composition and hierarchy but do not license unrelated illustration genres.
authorityModel.hardReject: Do not make later pages imitate P01/P02 composition, but also do not let a later page invent watercolor/vintage/painterly/SVG genres that break publication-family continuity.

principles: EDITORIAL_FIRST: decoration exists to help photos, headings, information blocks and reading flow; a beautiful standalone illustration is not automatically a good magazine ornament.
DENSE_BUT_READABLE: lively information density with strong size contrast, calm zones and clear hierarchy instead of uniform decorative noise.
PHOTO_AND_INFORMATION_LED: ornaments support editorial content and do not become the main subject unless the page Visual Master explicitly gives them that role.

MIXED_MEDIA_UNDER_ONE_ART_DIRECTION: photos, cutouts, doodles, icons, stamps, routes, paper objects and illustrations may mix, but high-saliency systems must remain inside one bounded publication-family realism/texture range.

PLAYFUL_EDITORIAL_UTILITY: arrows, routes, stickers, cutouts, badges and small motifs should guide attention, connect modules, activate edges or add narrative meaning rather than simply fill empty space.
TACTILE_PRINT_CHARACTER: use controlled hand-drawn/printed/paper character where useful, without turning the page into fine-art watercolor, vintage poster art or generic digital sticker packs.
LOCAL_VARIATION_WITH_GLOBAL_COHERENCE: page roles may change density and motif mix while remaining recognizably part of the same magazine.
hardRejects: standalone artwork whose beauty dominates its editorial usefulness
high-detail botanical art used as a major page ornament when it reads like an independent illustration plate
retro poster or watercolor illustration inserted into the V30 graphic family without an explicit publication-level reason
mixing painterly/vintage and flat-flowchart genres on one page
forcing every ornament into identical brushwork while also allowing unrelated visual genres to coexist

v30ArtDirection.principle: Translate the Rurubu editorial DNA into a joyful travel-wedding publication: bright, warm, tactile, photo-led, playful and print-oriented, but not childish, stock-like, painterly-vintage or over-illustrated.
styleDNA: strong dark outlines or equivalent high-contrast edge definition on high-saliency display art
white/yellow/bright keylines and controlled dimensional shadows where useful
clean cream/white paper treatment instead of aged parchment
tropical/travel motifs treated as lively editorial cutouts/stickers rather than fine-art botanical/watercolor illustration
restrained tactile print texture rather than sepia/vintage surface treatment
v30ArtDirection.controlledVariation: Different pages may vary composition, density and motif mix. They may not change the dominant illustration genre. Consistency means compatible graphic treatment and visual weight, not cloned layouts or identical assets.

crossPageStyleFamilyPolicy.comparison: Compare the current target-page screenshot side-by-side with locked P01/P02 CURRENT before design lock.
crossPageStyleFamilyPolicy.question: Does this page still look designed by the same V30 publication team even though its local composition is different?
hardRejects: ANTI_CANVA correction that escapes into watercolor/vintage/painterly genre
aged parchment/scrapbook paper replacing the clean V30 paper family
realistic botanical or watercolor tropical systems replacing bold editorial cutout/sticker grammar
retro travel-poster/church illustration becoming a page-specific dominant style
generic Canva/SVG icon and route systems
one page containing both painterly-vintage blocks and flat-flowchart/SVG blocks
individual object quality used to excuse publication-family mismatch
crossPageStyleFamilyPolicy.productionRule: Before broad generation on a new page, generate one representative high-saliency ecology/style sample and compare it against P01/P02. If it fails the family test, regenerate the ecology before producing the rest.
crossPageStyleFamilyPolicy.importantClarification: P01/P02 are style anchors only. Never copy their page layout, module count, exact tropical clusters or page-specific ornaments.

ornamentFamilyRegistry.principle: Families are reusable visual vocabularies, not libraries of identical repeated assets. A page selects or extends a family, then creates locally appropriate variants inside the V30 style family.

families.role: connect modules, imply movement, activate empty space
families.reuseMode: grammar shared; exact path/shape normally page-specific
families.styleGuard: must read as editorial movement, not flowchart connector grammar

examples: car where page role supports it
families.reuseMode: family character shared; vehicle and pose generated for local page role
families.styleGuard: bold V30 editorial cutout/sticker treatment; avoid generic flat SVG

families.reuseMode: botanical vocabulary may recur, but major clusters must be independently composed
families.styleGuard: graphic editorial cutout/sticker energy; reject watercolor botanical plates or realistic fine-art clusters

families.reuseMode: shared material/print treatment; object chosen for page meaning
families.styleGuard: clean print object, not aged scrapbook unless publication-wide authority changes

families.reuseMode: intentional recurring motif family; exact placement/combination varies
families.styleGuard: integrate into nearby ecology where practical; do not accumulate isolated icon-pack pieces

groupedEcologyPolicy.principle: When multiple fixed elements depend on one another for visual meaning, generate/design them as a larger editorial ecology instead of isolated icon assets.
groupedEcologyPolicy.microOrnamentRule: When an isolated camera/palm/plumeria/route/icon looks weak, do not automatically regenerate another isolated icon. Integrate it into the nearest ecology when useful or remove it.
hardRejects: five separate step badges plus an independent connector line
bundling replaceable photography or pending personal copy merely to reduce layer count

crossPageReuseFingerprintPolicy.principle: Page-specific ornament families may repeat visual grammar, but major page-specific assets must not silently reuse identical source bytes across pages.
requiredChecks: inspect Figma imageHash/source provenance where carry-over is possible
record declared reuse intent for exact matches
allowedExactReuse: small recurring MICRO_ACCENT explicitly declared shared

phases.action: Inventory ornament jobs/slots across reviewed Visual Masters; do not generate all final art.
Establish 1-2 representative family/style anchors. For new pages, compare one representative high-saliency ecology against P01/P02 before broad generation.
Create confirmed cross-page furniture once as shared systems.
Produce page-specific variants after target hierarchy/photos/copy/negative space are known; prefer grouped ecologies where dependencies are strong.
Write back family, page role, reuse intent, style-family pass, source fingerprints and alpha status.

pageAdditionWorkflow: read new page Visual Master for local composition
inspect locked P01/P02 for V30 style-family calibration
inventory ornament jobs and grouped ecologies
fail immediately if it drifts to watercolor/vintage/painterly/Canva-SVG/unrelated genre
map needs to existing ornament families where appropriate
futurePageScalability.hardRule: Adding a page must not require copying prior layouts or inventing a new dominant art genre.

evaluationGates.RURUBU_EDITORIAL_DNA_PASS: Does the ornament function as Rurubu-style editorial material rather than merely good standalone art?
evaluationGates.V30_ART_DIRECTION_PASS: Does it fit the Rurubu WEDDING V30 project translation?
evaluationGates.CROSS_PAGE_STYLE_FAMILY_PASS: Does the target page remain in the active P01/P02-calibrated V30 graphic family without copying their layout?
evaluationGates.PAGE_ROLE_FIT_PASS: Is its visual weight, motif and density appropriate for this specific page role?
evaluationGates.ORNAMENT_FAMILY_COHERENCE_PASS: Does it belong to its declared family while remaining a locally distinct variant?
evaluationGates.PAGE_SPECIFIC_ASSET_FINGERPRINT_PASS: Is there no undeclared exact major source reuse across pages?
evaluationGates.ORNAMENT_OBJECT_QUALITY_PASS: Is the asset itself well designed at required A5 size?
evaluationGates.REUSE_INTENT_PASS: Is repetition intentional publication language rather than convenience?
evaluationGates.TRUE_ALPHA_PREFLIGHT_PASS: Does floating art satisfy the current true-alpha policy?

antiPattern: Do not approve a beautiful object if it fails publication-family coherence. Technical cleanliness, different hash or local object quality never overrides CROSS_PAGE_STYLE_FAMILY_PASS.
